contract_ref.description: The contract or trust account the retention attaches to

project_ref.description: The subject project's stable external reference (today the ERP job number).

retention_amount.description: The amount currently withheld, as recorded by the source
retention_amount.x-demiton-unit: currency of the bound legal entity

retention_basis.description: How the retention was calculated (percent of each claim, accumulated, cap)

retention_currency.description: The currency the amount is denominated in

retention_held.description: Whether money is currently withheld by the client
